name: Myanmar
value: Civil war; no major city changed hands
summary: Arakan Army presses on Sittwe; no major city has changed hands
state: The Arakan Army has captured junta outposts around Sittwe township and attacked near the junta's regional command, while junta aircraft still operate from the city (BNI, 14 Oct). The AA reported sinking junta vessels near Sittwe on 26 Oct (Irrawaddy). No major city had changed hands as of 3 Nov.
for_you: FCDO advises against travel to much of Myanmar, including Rakhine State.
rubric_hit: Civil war at steady intensity = Watch

sources.title: The Irrawaddy — Myanmar navy loses more ships as AA tightens Sittwe noose

why: A multi-sided civil war affecting 50 million people, with spillover to China, Thailand, India and Bangladesh.
drivers: Resistance offensives, junta airstrikes, Chinese mediation, elections, humanitarian access.
